{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2026}}

'''Alexander Konstantinovich Guts''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Константинович Гуц}}; 30 August 1947 – 5 March 2026) was a Russian mathematician.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Гуц Александр Константинович |url=https://www.mathnet.ru/rus/person22926}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Guts was born on 30 August 1947 in [[Berlin]], in what was then the [[Soviet occupation zone in Germany|Soviet occupation zone]]. Throughout his career, he published more than 500 works and about 30 books and textbooks on mathematics, computer science, physics, sociology, history and ecology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Two professors of Omsk State University were presented by the Acting Governor with state awards |url=https://www.mngz.ru/russia-world-sensation/3661987-dvum-professoram-omgu-vrio-gubernatora-vruchil-gosudarstvennye-nagrady.html}}</ref>

From 1974 to 2024, he worked at [[Omsk State University]], and was the [[Dean (education)|dean]] of the Faculty of Computer Science (2001–2022).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Omsk State University, Faculty of Computer Science |url=http://fkn.univer.omsk.su/}}</ref>

Guts died on 5 March 2026, at the age of 78.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Объявлено о смерти создателя факультета компьютерных наук ОмГУ — СуперОмск |url=https://superomsk.ru/news/159146-obyavleno_o_smerti_sozdatelya_fakulteta_kompyutern/ |access-date=2026-03-18 |website=superomsk.ru}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 2017: Honored Worker of Higher Education of the Russian Federation<ref>{{Cite web |title=Владимир Путин наградил разработчика «машины времени» Александра Гуца |url=https://vomske.ru/news/4306-vladimir_putin_nagradil_razrabotchika_mashiny_vremeni/ |access-date=2026-03-18 |website=vomske.ru |language=ru}}</ref>
